whatThisDoesNotFix.theTwins: 645 `extends` edges bind to a declaration in ANOTHER file because the base type is declared in an imported namespace and no declaration in the edge's own file answers the name. The claim mapping does not touch that column — the intent classifier is independent of the claim mechanism. The fix the Lead named is the identity one: give the target an identity the store can match exactly instead of a name a tie-break must choose. `references` carries 4,137 of the same shape, so one mechanism may serve both.
